actions.label: Dodge
actions.description: Dash after the current action ends. The Normal Attack combo restarts at N1.

actions.label: Wait
actions.description: Do nothing for a set time (e.g. a teammate is on the field). The combo restarts at N1.

actions.label: Swap in
actions.description: Come on the field (after the swap cooldown and delay) and do nothing else: a Wait or Dash after it is this member's. The combo restarts at N1.
